EJPE Editorial Board History

Interactive view of active editorial-board membership by country, region, year, role, and affiliation. Historical honorific roles such as past and founding editors are kept in the source CSV but excluded from these plots.

Country Presence Across Years

Darker cells mean more board members from that country in that year. The table covers 1986–2022. Click a cell to inspect names and affiliations.
